headline: UKRAINE 🪖 HURLS 💥 450 DRONES 🛩️ At MOSCOW 🏙️ In LARGEST 🔥 BARRAGE Yet
text:
MOSCOW 🏛️ MAYOR 🧔 Sergei Sobyanin just DROPPED 💣 the BOMBSHELL 🧨 that UKRAINE 🇺🇦 UNLEASHED its LARGEST 🏋️ drone attack 🛫 yet on the capital region 🗺️ with HUNDREDS 🧮 of those buzzing 🐝 bastards 🪰 raining down 🌧️ overnight 🌙!! He claims 450 drones 🛸 were SHOT 🏹 DOWN ⬇️ in what he calls the MOST MASSIVE 💥 assault yet while the region's governor 🧑‍⚖️ confirmed at least TWO ☠️ people KILLED 💀 and TWENTY 🥈 more INJURED 🩹 from the chaos 🌪️. A MOSCOW 🏙️ oil refinery 🛢️ got TORCHED 🔥 after the Ukrainian strike 🎯 and a residential building 🏠 took a direct HIT 💥 too leaving everyone 😱 in the streets SCREAMING 🗣️. Videos 📹 verified by the BBC 🌐 show EXPLOSIONS 💥 lighting up the NIGHT SKY 🌌 above Moscow and a BURNING 🔥 warehouse 🏬 going up in flames 🔥 like a total inferno 🌋!! Ukrainian officials spilled that NINE ☠️ folks including THREE 👦 children got KILLED 💀 in Russian counter strikes 🎯 across Kyiv and Sumy regions on Saturday while both sides keep INTENSIFYING 🌀 their blows on energy plants ⚡ transport hubs 🚌 and logistics spots 📦 like it's the ultimate grudge match 🥊.

PRESIDENT 🧔‍♂️ Volodymyr Zelensky CONFIRMED ✅ that Kyiv's forces SMASHED 💥 a KEY 🔑 Russian oil facility 🛢️ plus a logistics site 📍 in the region using DRONES 🛫 and MISSILES 🚀 which he says equals BILLIONS 💰 of dollars 💵 keeping that Russian war machine 🏭 HUMMING 🌀 along. A 44 year old woman 👩 got KILLED 💀 in Sofyino 🏘️ after a drone 🛸 slammed into a three storey residential building 🏢 with regional head Andrei Vorobyev confirming another FIVE 🖐️ injured including TWO 👦 children from the blast 💥. An ELDERLY 👴 man also DIED ☠️ when a private house 🏠 got PUMMELED 🥊 in the Orekhovo Zuevo district according to Governor Andrei Vorobyev who dropped those grim updates 📢 like they were nothing. Mayor Sobyanin added that a drone 🛸 smacked a building 🏗️ near one of the capital's boulevards 🌳 and the oil refinery 🛢️ where Ukrainian military sources claim THREE 3️⃣ key units got DAMAGED 🛠️ badly enough to slow the flow. That site pumps out MORE THAN A THIRD 📊 of the Moscow region's fuel ⛽ with its petrol 🛢️ diesel 🚛 and aviation fuel ✈️ heading straight to Russia's military forces 🪖 keeping their engines 🛠️ RUNNING 🏃‍♂️ hot.

UKRAINE'S 🟦 defence minister straight up said hitting these facilities 🎯 DIRECTLY UNDERMINES the enemy's ability to keep waging its war of aggression 🛡️ and supplying its military formations 🪖 like a total knockout punch 🥊 to their logistics chain. Sobyanin called the whole MASSIVE 🏋️ attack an attempt to DISRUPT 🌀 Russia's parliamentary election 🗳️ which was grinding through its third day 📅 on Sunday in a vote tightly controlled by the Kremlin 🏛️ and dismissed by critics as neither free fair nor transparent at all. Russian state media reported an election official 🗳️ was one of TWO ☠️ people KILLED 💀 by a drone strike 🛸 on a bus 🚌 in a Moscow controlled part of Kherson in Ukraine on Sunday citing the head of Russia's election commission. Meanwhile Moscow's BIGGEST ✈️ airport Sheremetyevo issued warnings about temporary restrictions 🛑 overnight while Vnukovo airport completely HALTED ✋ all arrivals and departures with the bans lifted by Sunday morning though delays lingered on some flights 🛫 like a total mess.

THIS ALL COMES 🔥 right after a mother 👩 and her TWO 👦 small children a boy and a girl got KILLED ☠️ in a Russian attack in the city of Fastiv near Kyiv on Saturday according to regional head Tymur Tkachenko who later confirmed a child injured in a separate strike in Vyshhorod north of Kyiv also DIED 🪦 in hospital from the wounds. In the north eastern Sumy region FOUR ☠️ people were WIPED OUT 💥 when a Russian drone 🛸 slammed into the car 🚗 they were travelling in according to top local official Oleh Hryhorov dropping those horrific details. Russia also STRUCK 🎯 a monastery ⛪ in the Kherson region with a drone 🛸 on Saturday killing one member of the clergy 🧔 and injuring FOUR more as Zelensky himself confirmed the brutal hit. Both Russia and Ukraine have kept POUNDING 💥 energy infrastructure targets 🏭 in the past week despite US President Donald Trump claiming on social media that the two sides had agreed not to target that stuff anymore like some kind of magical truce ✌️ that never stuck.

TRUMP 🧑‍💼 signed a sanctions bill 📜 on Friday that targets Russia's economy by slapping tariffs on the biggest buyers of the country's oil 🛢️ and gas ⛽ which include China and India in a major economic squeeze. The US legislation gives the US president powers to impose 100 PERCENT 💯 tariffs on major purchasers of Russian energy which is basically a financial nuke 💣 aimed at their wallet. Russian President Vladimir Putin launched that full scale invasion of Ukraine back in February 2022 and the hits just keep coming like an endless grudge 🥊 that won't quit. A four minute warning isn't enough as Russia's new relentless missile tactics exhaust Kyiv residents while Russian hybrid attacks against Europe keep intensifying according to Macron who called it all out loud and clear 📢. The whole barrage left the city on edge with videos 📹 showing the night skies above Moscow exploding in fireballs 🔥 and warehouses burning bright into the dawn 🌅 like some apocalyptic scene straight from a nightmare 🌀!!
